seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Sölden in Tyrol, Austria.

h1: Sölden ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Sölden has 147.2 kilometres of slopes served by 31 lifts, and three peaks above 3,000 metres that the resort calls the Big 3. Two glacier roads climb out of the Ötztal, and the Gaislachkogl summit station stands on bare rock.

kpis.label: Slopes
kpis.note: across three areas and two glaciers

stayOverview: Sölden on the valley floor has the gondolas and the nightlife; Hochsölden above it is car-free, higher and quieter.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Hochsölden trades the bars for ski-in ski-out and snow reliability.
rentalCars: Sölden is well up the Ötztal; the nearest railway is at Ötztal Bahnhof and a car or transfer is the normal way in.
